decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service built on the firm's established production and fits its stated promise of fast response, so the firm has little reason to abandon a commitment it has made publicly.

The seventy-two-hour delivery is operationally demanding, but it was announced publicly and supports the firm's fast-response positioning, so management would likely attribute any strain to temporary causes and persist.
This express line has several models and its own page in both years, a visible investment that makes it the umbrella for the express strategy and unlikely to be withdrawn.

The online ordering and digital services platform carries substantial sunk investment and is central to the announced direction of deeper service and advisory support, so commitment to it should escalate rather than end.
The fire and smoke protection door moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, a sign of growing commitment, and it serves the firm's core safety-compliance positioning.
